description: For the account's own wallet: two unsigned transactions in order, StandingOrders.setOrder(agentId, creditsBps, gasBps, gasTarget, minRun), then VladBank.moveTo(agentId, StandingOrders). Send setOrder first and wait for it to confirm before sending moveTo. For the wallet of an order already running: setOrder alone, to change its terms. Defaults: credits 75, gas 25 (percent of each day's gains), gasTarget 0.0003 ETH (at most 0.01), minRun 1 dollar (at least 0.50). Cancel any time; the account moves straight back.

agentId.description: The ERC-8004 agentId on Robinhood Chain, as a decimal string or integer.

credits.description: Percent of each day's gains paid as AI credits on Raeto, 0 to 100. Default 75.

gas.description: Percent of each day's gains, at most, used to top the wallet's ETH up to gasTarget. Default 25.

gasTarget.description: ETH the wallet is topped up to, at most 0.01. Default 0.0003.

minRun.description: Dollars of gains a day before anything is paid, at least 0.50. Default 1.

wallet.description: The account's wallet now (or the wallet of its running order).
